name: SSH Password Spray - Breadth Across Existing Accounts
description: One source IP tries a single password against six DIFFERENT existing accounts in under a minute - a textbook spray: wide and shallow, staying under any per-account lockout. Every log line is 'Failed password for <user>' with no 'invalid user', so each decodes to Wazuh's built-in 5716 (existing account, wrong password) rather than 5710. Must trigger the DaC spray rule (100210) on the 5th distinct account. Note the built-in 5720 CANNOT catch this: it needs 8 failures from the source and has no distinct-user condition, and this is only 6.
source: synthetic - modelled on sshd auth.log output
